name: Gargamelle bubble chamber
notes: No placement is recorded: no fetched source locates the hall of the PS neutrino area, and the chamber later moved to the SPS (home.cern: before moving to the SPS until 1979). Placing it on the CERN campus point would make that site take its timeline from this detector alone (the globe derives a site's presence from the detectors placed there) and hide the campus outside 1970-1979, so the experiment sits on facility:cern and the collaboration names the campus site as its host, as for UA1.

summary.plain: A giant tank of liquid freon, 4.8 metres long, in which a passing charged particle leaves a trail of bubbles that cameras photograph. Neutrinos leave no tracks, so it showed them only through the charged particles they knocked into motion.
summary.technical: Heavy-liquid bubble chamber (CF3Br), 4.8 m long and 2 m in diameter, about 1000 t, photographed in the PS (1970-76) and SPS neutrino beams.

technology.quote: held nearly 12 cubic metres of heavy-liquid freon (CF3Br)
technology.value: Heavy-liquid bubble chamber filled with freon (CF3Br)
